license_note: Dimensional and rating FACTS only. No Schneider drawings, CAD/BIM/LayoutFAST output, catalog prose or images are stored. See ../LICENSE_NOTES.md.

collection_posture.summary: se.com blocks non-browser clients (403 to every automated fetch; docs/product/content-strategy.md row 3). Facts were read from the Schneider Electric Digest 178 (0100CT1901) Section 9 'Panelboards', dated 9/1/2023, as a PDF hosted by an electrical distributor. One manual-equivalent read; factual figures only. Schneider's site ToU (personal / non-commercial 'license to consult'; LayoutFAST EULA unread) is recorded in content-strategy row 3 as UNKNOWN -> NEEDS COUNSEL for anything beyond bare facts.
collection_posture.method: single WebFetch of the distributor-hosted PDF + local text extraction; figures transcribed by hand

nq_box_width_standard_in.note: NQ and NF standard box 20 in W x 5.75 in D (NEMA Type 1 MHxx boxes).

nq_box_depth_deep_in.note: D9 suffix = 8.75 in deep box, required for PowerPacT L main breaker / switch / sub-feed breaker.

nq_box_width_wide_in.note: 26 in W x 8.75 in D vented Type 3R / large sub-feed configurations.

nq_box_heights_in.note: MHxx box catalog numbers encode the height in inches (MH26 ... MH86).

nq_narrow_mlo_width_in.note: A 14-inch-wide NQ main-lug option exists (Table 9.7 title).

enclosure_types.note: NEMA 3R/5/12 enclosures must be bottom fed (NQ12RDE kit).

mounting.note: Selection procedure: 'NEMA Type-1, surface-mount' example; trim fronts flush/surface.

kaic_summary.note: 'Series rated up to 200 kAIC with integral main circuit breaker - fully rated up to 65 kAIC' (NQ/NF factory-assembled feature list).

weights.note: NOT SOURCED - Section 9 does not tabulate weights. Do not emit a weight parameter.

nf_column_width_dims_in.note: NF single-row (column-width) 480Y/277: box width 8.625 in (9.69 in over the front flange) x 5.625 in deep; heights 59 (30 poles, 125 A MLO), 71 (42 poles, 225 A MLO), 65 / 85 (main-breaker interiors).

variants.role: lighting and appliance panelboard, 240 Vac / 48 Vdc, plug-on (QO) and bolt-on (QOB) branch breakers

options.row_format: [max pole spaces, NEMA Type 1 box height (in) for the 20 W x 5.75 D box, example interior catalog number] - the 400/600 A rows also list 62/68/80-in tall D9V (8.75 D vented 3R) enclosures
